assignments.description: Fault-path terminal for all 10 record lookups. Writes out_didError=true + a generic message; no connector so subflow returns to caller. Caller inspects out_didError post-return and routes to its own Error_CouldNotLoadData terminal Finish per plan §Error-screen-boundary (Shape B).
assignments.name: Assign_DidError_True
assignments.label: Set: subflow error (any lookup fault)

value.stringValue: Could not load record. Please try again — if the problem persists, contact your Salesforce admin.

assignments.description: PP-inherited entry: seeds subflow_rsv_Campaign.Id from the caller-supplied in_selectedCampaignId so the resolver's Tier 3 lookups (Get_Campaign_Default_Designations, Get_Campaign_GDDs_Multi) can filter on it. Only runs when in_selectedCommitmentId is non-null — Pledge Payment path where monolith's Assign_Campaign_From_Commitment_Selected already resolved the Campaign from the parent GC.
assignments.name: Assign_Seed_Campaign_Id
assignments.label: Seed subflow Campaign Id (PP path)

assignments.description: Resolver Tier 3 Campaign_Default terminal. Ported unchanged from monolith except now writes rsv_SelectedDesignation.Id (subflow-local SObject) instead of relying on monolith's rsv_SelectedDesignation.
assignments.name: Assign_Resolve_Designation_CampaignDefault
assignments.label: Resolved: from Campaign default

assignments.description: Resolver Tier 0 Platform_Split terminal. Deliberately does NOT populate rsv_SelectedDesignation.Id — caller-side Decide_Create_Designation and Decide_Create_Default_Designation gate on .Id being non-null; leaving it null preserves platform native multi-row fanout.
assignments.name: Assign_Resolve_Designation_PlatformSplit
assignments.label: Resolved: platform split (multi-GDD)

assignments.description: Override terminal (Tier 4). Fires after Pick_Designation resolves. Copies rsv_SelectedDesignation.Id into var_ResolvedDesignationId so downstream reads see the user-picked designation. Connector was → Decide_After_Designation in monolith; here routes to Assign_Set_ResolvedPath_Accepted so subflow returns cleanly.
assignments.name: Assign_Resolve_Designation_UserOverride
assignments.label: Resolved: user override

assignments.description: Sets var_ResolverHasGCDefault=true after Decide_GC_Has_Default_Designation confirms the parent GC has a GDD.
assignments.name: Assign_ResolverHasGCDefault_True
assignments.label: Set: resolver has GC default

assignments.description: Multi-GDD support — set true after Count_Campaign_GDDs assigns var_CampaignGDDCount > 1. Reached from Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_Campaign; connector continues to Decide_Route_Outright_To_Resolver.
assignments.name: Assign_Set_PlatformSplitApplies_True_Campaign
assignments.label: Set: Platform Split (Campaign multi-GDD)

assignments.description: Multi-GDD support — set true after Count_GC_GDDs assigns var_GCGDDCount > 1. Reached from Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_GC on PP branch; connector continues to Get_Campaign_Default_Designations (Tier 3 lookup) skipping Tier 2.
assignments.name: Assign_Set_PlatformSplitApplies_True_GC
assignments.label: Set: Platform Split (GC multi-GDD)

assignments.description: Accepted-path terminal. Writes out_resolvedPath="Accepted" + out_selectedCampaignId (from subflow_rsv_Campaign.Id — which is populated by whichever entry path ran). No connector — subflow returns control to caller.
assignments.name: Assign_Set_ResolvedPath_Accepted
assignments.label: Set: resolved path = Accepted

assignments.description: MissingOrgDefault-path terminal. Writes out_resolvedPath="MissingOrgDefault" so caller routes to its own Error_MissingDefaultDesignation terminal Finish (monolith owns the terminal Finish screen — subflow Finish would end the whole interview).
assignments.name: Assign_Set_ResolvedPath_MissingOrgDefault
assignments.label: Set: resolved path = MissingOrgDefault

assignments.description: Multi-GDD support — counts Get_Campaign_GDDs_Multi into var_CampaignGDDCount AND copies the collection into out_campaignGDDs (caller-side Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_Campaign iterates it). Routes to Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_Campaign.
assignments.name: Count_Campaign_GDDs
assignments.label: Count Campaign GDDs

assignments.description: Multi-GDD support — counts Get_GC_GDDs_Multi into var_GCGDDCount AND copies the collection into out_gcGDDs (caller-side Loop_Fanout_Split_GTDs_GC iterates). Only reachable on PP branch. Routes to Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_GC.
assignments.name: Count_GC_GDDs
assignments.label: Count GC GDDs

decisions.description: Reads Get_GC_Default_Designation_For_Resolver.Id (safe here because the lookup DID run on this branch). Routes to Assign_ResolverHasGCDefault_True if the parent GC has a GDD, or straight to Get_Campaign_Default_Designations if not.
decisions.name: Decide_GC_Has_Default_Designation
decisions.label: GC has default designation?
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: No GC default — continue to Campaign

decisions.description: Confirm_Designation Override-checkbox router. Checked → Decide_Override_Needs_Restriction; Unchecked → Assign_Set_ResolvedPath_Accepted (was Decide_After_Designation in monolith; subflow terminates here).
decisions.name: Decide_Override_Designation
decisions.label: Override designation?

decisions.description: On Override path, commitment-creation leaves (Simple / Scheduled / Recurring) go to Pick_Restriction first so var_RestrictionType is set before Get_Filtered_Designations filters Pick_Designation. Payment/Special leaves go straight to Pick_Designation. Rewritten from monolith Choice_Leaf_* elementReference comparisons to inline stringValue comparisons — subflow doesn't share choice records with caller flow.
decisions.name: Decide_Override_Needs_Restriction
decisions.label: Override — needs restriction first?
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: Payment / Special leaf — straight to picker

decisions.description: Org-default presence gate inside Resolve_Designation_Hierarchy. Terminal fork: found → Assign_Resolve_Designation_OrgDefault; not found → Assign_Set_ResolvedPath_MissingOrgDefault (subflow return with status; caller owns terminal Finish).
decisions.name: Decide_Resolver_Has_Org_Default
decisions.label: Resolver — has org default?

decisions.description: Subflow entry router. Three paths: (a) in_selectedCommitmentId non-null → PP-inherited path — seed Campaign Id from caller then run GC-side chain first. (b) in_leafSpecial = InKind or EarnedIncome → optional Campaign picker. (c) default → required Campaign picker.
decisions.name: Decide_Resolver_Entry
decisions.label: Resolver entry router

rules.name: Decide_Resolver_Entry_IsPPInherited
rules.label: PP-inherited — seed Campaign, jump to GC-side chain

rules.name: Decide_Resolver_Entry_IsSpecialOptional
rules.label: InKind or EarnedIncome — optional Campaign picker

decisions.description: Leaf gate — forks resolver-ready leaves into Resolve_Designation_Hierarchy. 8 rules cover every live leaf; default (Legacy R3 chain in monolith) now routes to Get_Org_Default_Designation as a defensive fallback — the default is unreachable in every documented leaf, but if inputs go unset the org-default lookup path is the safest exit. Rewritten from Choice_Leaf_* elementReference comparisons to inline stringValue comparisons.
decisions.name: Decide_Route_Outright_To_Resolver
decisions.label: Route to resolver?

decisions.description: Multi-GDD support — after Count_Campaign_GDDs assigns var_CampaignGDDCount, if >1 set Platform_Split flag; otherwise pass through to leaf gate.
decisions.name: Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_Campaign
decisions.label: Campaign has >1 GDDs?

decisions.description: Multi-GDD support — after Count_GC_GDDs on PP branch, if >1 set Platform_Split flag and skip Tier 2; otherwise proceed with normal Tier 2 flow.
decisions.name: Decide_Set_PlatformSplit_From_GC
decisions.label: GC has >1 GDDs?

decisions.description: Pledge Payment Update branch skips Confirm_Designation. Keyed only on in_pledgePaymentMode='Update' — the second guard on rsv_SelectedGT.Id (present in the monolith) can't be safely projected as a subflow input per [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]] (Assign of unread SObject.Id throws). Update-mode is set via a radio selection so is always safely readable; if pkPledgePaymentMode='Update' without a selected GT that's an upstream data-integrity bug, not something to defend against here.
decisions.name: Decide_Skip_Confirm_On_Update
decisions.label: Skip Confirm on PP Update?

rules.name: Decide_Skip_Confirm_On_Update_IsUpdate
rules.label: Update mode — skip Confirm, keep existing GTDs

decisions.description: Route based on the checkbox: unchecked → table path, checked → lookup.
decisions.name: Decide_Use_Campaign_Lookup
decisions.label: Use Campaign lookup?

decisions.description: Optional Campaign screen's lookup gate. Mirrors Decide_Use_Campaign_Lookup on the required path; distinct because the optional screen has its own checkbox variable so the two screens don't collide.
decisions.name: Decide_Use_Campaign_Lookup_Optional
decisions.label: Use Campaign lookup? (Optional)

decisions.description: Route Pick_Designation exit: unchecked lookup box → Assign_Resolve_Designation_UserOverride (accept the datatable pick); checked → Get_Looked_Up_Designation (which writes rsv_SelectedDesignation via outputReference then falls through to Assign_Resolve_Designation_UserOverride).
decisions.name: Decide_Use_Designation_Lookup
decisions.label: Use Designation lookup?

decisions.description: The resolver Decision — owns the precedence hierarchy: Tier 0 Platform_Split (Campaign or GC has >1 GDDs) → Tier 2 GC_Default (Pledge Payment) → Tier 3 Campaign_Default → Tier 5 fallthrough to Get_Org_Default_Designation.
decisions.name: Resolve_Designation_Hierarchy
decisions.label: Resolve Designation Hierarchy
decisions.defaultConnectorLabel: Tier 5 — fall through to org default

rules.name: Resolve_Designation_Hierarchy_TierPlatformSplit
rules.label: Tier 0 — platform split (Campaign or GC has >1 GDDs)

formulas.description: Confirm_Designation summary line. CASE-branches on var_ResolvedDesignationSource. ISBLANK guards on Get_Resolved_GD.Name for defensive null-handling.
formulas.name: formulaResolvedDesignationSummary
formulas.expression: "Applying: " & IF(ISBLANK({!Get_Resolved_GD.Name}), "(no designation resolved)", {!Get_Resolved_GD.Name}) & " " & CASE({!var_ResolvedDesignationSource}, "Campaign_Default", "— from the campaign’s default.", "GC_Default", "— from the commitment’s default.", "Org_Default", "— the org default. No campaign or commitment default set.", "User_Override", "— chosen manually.", "")

formulas.description: Multi-GDD support — number of GDDs contributing to the platform split. Picks the GC count when >1 (PP branch takes precedence), otherwise the Campaign count.

formulas.description: Multi-GDD support — renders "campaign" or "commitment" in the Platform_Split explanation.
formulas.name: formulaSplitSource

recordLookups.name: Get_Campaign_Default_Designations
recordLookups.label: Get Campaign Default Designations

recordLookups.description: Multi-GDD support — collection sibling of Get_Campaign_Default_Designations. Returns ALL active GDDs on the picked Campaign for count-based split detection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Campaign_GDDs_Multi
recordLookups.label: Get Campaign GDDs (Multi)

recordLookups.description: Active GiftDesignations filtered by var_RestrictionType. Used by the Override-branch Pick_Designation datatable.
recordLookups.name: Get_Filtered_Designations
recordLookups.label: Get Filtered Designations

recordLookups.description: Tier 2 (GC_Default) lookup for the Pledge Payment resolver path. Filter reads in_selectedCommitmentId scalar (String) — safe on branches where the GC lookup never ran, no unread-SObject-field trap.

recordLookups.label: Get GC Default Designation (Resolver)

recordLookups.description: Multi-GDD support — collection sibling of Get_GC_Default_Designation_For_Resolver. Only reachable on PP branch.
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_GDDs_Multi
recordLookups.label: Get GC GDDs (Multi)

recordLookups.description: Escape-hatch Campaign lookup (required screen). Writes via outputReference to subflow_rsv_Campaign so downstream reads see .Id populated without needing a follow-on Assign — avoids [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]].
recordLookups.name: Get_Looked_Up_Campaign
recordLookups.label: Get Looked-Up Campaign

recordLookups.description: Escape-hatch Campaign lookup (optional screen). Same outputReference pattern as Get_Looked_Up_Campaign.

recordLookups.label: Get Looked-Up Campaign (Optional)

recordLookups.name: Get_Looked_Up_Designation
recordLookups.label: Get Looked-Up Designation

recordLookups.description: Org-wide default GiftDesignation — last-resort fallback in the resolver hierarchy. The subflow only reaches this step when neither GC-default nor Campaign-default resolved.

recordLookups.name: Get_Resolved_GD
recordLookups.label: Get Resolved GiftDesignation

fields.helpText: Purpose = donor named a specific program, project, or fund. Time = donor said WHEN it must be used (e.g., "for our FY27 budget") — multi-year pledges paid in installments are NOT time-restricted unless the donor said so. Permanent = endowment or permanently restricted principal. If a gift is genuinely both Purpose and Time, pick the stricter one here and adjust on the record.

variables.description: Pledge Payment context Commitment Id — when set on the Guide entry path.

variables.description: Projected from caller's pkLeafMonetary screen auto-var via Assign_Resolver_Inputs. Values: "Outright" / "PledgePayment" / "Recurring".

variables.description: Projected from caller's pkPledgePaymentMode screen auto-var. Values: "Update" / "Direct" / blank.

Non-null means subflow skips Pick_Campaign(Optional) and seeds subflow_rsv_Campaign.Id directly.

variables.description: True when any subflow record lookup faults. Caller inspects post-return and routes to its own Error_CouldNotLoadData terminal Finish per Shape B pattern.

variables.name: out_errorMessage

variables.description: Return-status discriminator. Caller routes on this: "Accepted" → downstream monolith continues; "MissingOrgDefault" → caller's Error_MissingDefaultDesignation terminal.
variables.name: out_resolvedPath

variables.name: out_selectedCampaignId

Read by Get_Campaign_Default_Designations + Get_Campaign_GDDs_Multi filter operands (.Id).
